title: HtmlInputUrl
responsibility: Renders the native input control with type url without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlInputUrl.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte snippet accepted as children; when omitted, its value is undefined. The implementation discards it, and the native input element cannot render child content.

outputs.name: HtmlInputUrl
outputs.description: A native input element that spreads the remaining supplied attributes and sets type to url, overriding any supplied type attribute. It adds no wrapper or child content.
